cohort: 801,443 singleton live-born term births in Sweden; 1,929 women with bariatric surgery history and matched controls
finding: Bariatric surgery-induced weight loss was associated with lower risks for various adverse delivery outcomes in term births, including Cesarean delivery, instrumental delivery, and postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Post-surgery women were less likely to have Cesarean delivery, especially emergency Cesarean.
